blocks.text: When to Use: Lists are versatile and useful when you need to store an ordered collection of elements. They are especially appropriate when the order of elements matters, but direct access to elements by index is also needed. Use lists in:

items: Dynamic Arrays: Where you need to frequently add or remove elements.
Storing Sequences: Such as the order of elements in a to-do list or playlist.
Implementing Other Data Structures: Lists can be used as the building blocks for stacks, queues, and more.
